title: phacelia congesta var. rupestris
intro: Phacelia congesta var. rupestris, commonly known as Desert Phacelia, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. Desert Phacelia is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support immune function. It contains bioactive constituents like alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
